name: Tikona Fort
tagline: A pyramid-shaped fort with sweeping views over Pawna Lake
seoTitle: Tikona Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Tikona Fort near Pawna Lake — an easy pyramid-shaped fort climb, season, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — Pawna Lake and surrounding hills at their greenest

routeOptions.name: From Tikona Peth
routeOptions.notes: Short, steady ascent to the fort's distinctive pyramid-shaped summit.

safety.intro: Tikona is a low-risk, popular short trek, often combined with a stop at Pawna Lake for camping.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Often combined with Pawna Lake camping — plan gear accordingly if staying over
Weekend crowds are common near the lake

cards.title: On the trail
items: Some rocky sections near the summit need careful footing when wet
Short enough to combine with a half-day plan

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Popular and easy to find company on the trail
Lake-side camping areas can get crowded/noisy on weekends if seeking solitude
